LBR.note: Programme is for young people, not civil servants.
Hubs are youth skills centres; no rural or underserved areas stated.

facts.fact: The Liberia Telecommunications Authority and the Ministry of Youth & Sports signed an MOU to set up 15 Youth Digital Skills Hubs, with LTA funding a three-month training expected to benefit about 750 young people.

systems.owner: Liberia Telecommunications Authority and Ministry of Youth & Sports

LBR.note: No strategy named beyond a general digital transformation agenda.
Starlink equipment is supplied to the hubs, not sold to households or businesses.
Nothing on school internet or a compulsory subject.
